brief:
Jewish demonstrators joined a Free Palestine march to denounce Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, Al Jazeera English reported. The protesters rejected Netanyahu's leadership during the demonstration, which drew participants expressing opposition to his policies.

The march reflected divisions within Jewish communities over Israel's current government and Palestinian rights, with Jewish activists using the platform to voice their dissent from Netanyahu's approach.
dek: Al Jazeera’s Emma Withrow reports from a Free Palestine march, where Jewish demonstrators rejected Netanyahu.
title: Jewish protesters march against Netanyahu in Free Palestine demonstration
